{{Short description|FIFA World Cup group}} {{pp-protected|small=yes}} {{Use mdy dates|date=December 2025}} {{Use American English|date=November 2025}} '''Group C''' of the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] is taking place from June 13 to 24, 2026.{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/1be9ce37eb98fcc5/original/FWC26-Match-Schedule_English.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 26 – Match Schedule |publisher=[[FIFA]] |date=February 4, 2024 |access-date=February 4, 2024}} The group consists of [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]], [[Morocco national football team|Morocco]], [[Haiti national football team|Haiti]], and [[Scotland national football team|Scotland]]. The top two teams, possibly along with the third-placed team, will advance to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 32|round of 32]].{{cite web |url=https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |title=FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations |publisher=FIFA |date=May 2025 |access-date=June 7, 2025 |archive-date=June 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250623212158/https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf |url-status=live}} Brazil, Morocco and Scotland were also drawn together in [[1998 FIFA World Cup Group A|Group A]] in the [[1998 FIFA World Cup|1998 edition]] of the competition, which was also Scotland's latest appearance prior to this tournament. ==Teams== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !rowspan=2| Draw position !rowspan=2| Team !rowspan=2| Pot !rowspan=2| Confederation !rowspan=2| Method of

The score will be calculated based on yellow and red cards received by players and team officials in all group matches as follows: *yellow card: −1 point; *indirect red card (second yellow card): −3
